ai_summary: The extension is a legitimate client for a local AI server (FastFlowLM). It uses standard VS Code APIs to register a language model provider, manage a local server process via child_process (as documented in the README), and provide a chat interface via a webview. All network traffic is directed to a user-configured local endpoint. The static scanner hits are false positives resulting from standard chat UI patterns and local server communication. There are no signs of malicious intent, credential harvesting, or unauthorized data exfiltration.
